description: The line plot titled "Performance w.r.t. Temperature" illustrates the relationship between temperature and accuracy for two different methods, On-policy RL and SFT, across a range of temperatures. The x-axis, labeled "Temperature," is a linear scale ranging from 0.1 to 1.0, with tick labels at every 0.1 interval. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy (Pass@8)," is also a linear scale ranging from 62.5 to 80.0, with tick labels at every 2.5 interval. The On-policy RL method is represented by a red line with star markers, while the SFT method is represented by a blue line with triangle markers. The On-policy RL line shows a general upward trend in accuracy as the temperature increases, starting at approximately 65.0 and peaking at around 80.0. The SFT line exhibits more variability, with accuracy fluctuating between approximately 70.0 and 75.0 across the temperature range.
